summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the transformer/switchgear/power-quality chokepoint with a two-lane funnel. Reference context remains Eaton/Schneider/ABB/Siemens/GE Vernova/Vertiv, but this pass surfaces four smaller or more niche US-listed names tied to electrical distribution, voltage-control, transmission hardware, or custom switchgear. Powell Industries is included despite now screening near/above the preferred cap range because its exposure to switchgear/electrical distribution and data-center-adjacent capacity is unusually direct.
